noch-nicht: Similarity has not been calculated yet for the documents in this folder. The package will catch up in the background.
fehler: Similar documents can’t be loaded right now.
chip.titel: No word match: the document “{dokument}” is similar to your search ({prozent} %).
werkbank.text: This package calculates a vector for every document with full text. Ablago compares them and shows similar documents on the folder and in the search.
werkbank.stand: {mit} of {gesamt} documents with full text calculated
werkbank.stand.leer: No document with full text yet.
werkbank.suche.hilfe: When searching all folders with “also in documents”, folders with similar documents then appear as well, marked “similar”.
werkbank.neu.text: The existing vectors are deleted; the package recalculates them in the background. Until then, similar documents are missing.
werkbank.neu.fertig: {anzahl} vectors removed – the package recalculates them in the background.
